title: Bubble Girl Action Sequence
description: Four vertical panels display a pink-haired anime girl in green and black attire performing a dynamic sequence of movements against a solid green background. She starts surrounded by floating bubbles with a surprised expression, runs forward with determination, stomps the ground creating a splash of bubbles and particles, and finishes in a powerful fighting stance with one arm raised.
prompt: A four-panel vertical sequence showing the same anime girl with bright pink hair in pigtails, wearing a green and black battle outfit with boots and gloves. In the first panel she is surrounded by translucent bubbles with a surprised open mouth expression. She then runs forward powerfully, stomps the ground creating an explosion of bubbles and water splashes, and ends in a strong fighting stance with one fist raised. Clean cel-shaded anime style on a bright lime green background.
